what: Amendment 2 to the fit evaluation protocol, for the cycle after v4: fresh test 1 becomes the selection set, fresh test 2 (built and sealed in the same commit as this file) is the new sealed test, scored once after the pick is committed.

amends.unchanged: Everything protocol.json and amendment 1 pin that this file does not change: the system definition (TAG+H' = hybrid_rules.VARIANTS['H_prime'] on the Adaption-extracted card with rules.mark_thin), the label read from float32 first-token scores (evalstats.pick, ties Skip > Explore > Keep), colab_eval bf16 batch 1 with one adapter per Colab L4 session, the eligibility-pass definition (no HP_CATS hard Skip and no salary cap, recomputed from profile and card), macro-F1 as evalstats.macro_f1_of, the two-way bootstrap (2000 draws, numpy default_rng(20261021), postings then rows within them, one draw set per slice shared by every system), the slice definitions, the baselines' definitions and reporting results as they are.
amends.replaces: dev_fit (rules-made gold) no longer selects; amendment 1's pass rule (beat skills-free rules) is replaced for fresh test 2 by the bar below.

written_before: Any model output on fresh test 2 exists and before any fresh test 2 gold exists. Fresh test 2 was built without opening fresh test 1's model outputs or error lists (data/models/v4_eval/fresh_test/, FRESH_TEST.md).

fresh_test_1.role: the selection set for this cycle
fresh_test_1.never_trained_on: Its rows, its postings and its employers stay out of every training file this cycle (train csv, DPO pairs, any dev or selection set built for training). A builder that reads the train pool cannot reach them (the test pool is disjoint from the train pool by employer); any new training file states that it was checked against eval/fresh_test_manifest.json posting_ids and employers.
fresh_test_1.may: be used to diagnose errors (model outputs, error lists, slices) and to design rules or extractor fixes
fresh_test_1.gold: stays as sealed: data/built/fresh_test/gold.jsonl sha256 eef1d5699056b982d09bcfa1e7550348a2b26a5f6a6ffe09aca6ea32309be572 (eval/fresh_test_gold_manifest.json); never relabeled, even where diagnosis finds a gold row it disagrees with (such rows are reported, not changed)

fresh_test_2.role: the new sealed test: scored once, after the pick is committed
fresh_test_2.built: scripts/build_fresh_test.py --set 2: every English test-pool posting fresh test 1 did not use, same v2 extractor (blueprint b2b2ed8e, imported unchanged), same resume writer prompt and gates, same candidate design, new seed 20261122, row ids f2_...
fresh_test_2.gold: two blind labelers (Opus and Sonnet) on data/built/fresh_test2/label_batches/ only (row_id, posting, resume, profile form), the same rubric and the same adjudication as fresh test 1; gold.jsonl is pinned by eval/fresh_test2_gold_manifest.json (gold_sha256) and committed before any model is run on fresh test 2.
fresh_test_2.scored_once: scripts/fit_eval_score.py fresh2 reads the pick from the committed selection json (tracked, unchanged from HEAD, 'amendment': 'eval/protocol_amendment_2.json'), checks rows and cards against this manifest and gold against its gold manifest, writes eval/fresh_test2_result.json (+ .md) and refuses to run when that file exists.
fresh_test_2.inference: model outputs on fresh test 2 are produced only after the selection json is committed, for the pick, h, d3 and the untrained base (the systems the bar and the report need), each once.

candidates.runs: new runs trained this cycle (tags h2, h2a, h2b, ...; fit_eval_score.CANDIDATE_RX '^h(2\w*)?$') and run h as the incumbent. d3 and the base are reported, never selected.

selection.rule: The candidate whose system TAG+H' has the highest macro-F1 on all fresh test 1 rows. Within 0.01 (best - h <= 0.01, compared on values rounded to 6 decimals) the incumbent h stays.
selection.tool: scripts/fit_eval_score.py select --score h=... --score h2a=... --out eval/selection_v5.json; the selection json is committed before any fresh test 2 model output exists
selection.rules_changes: a rules or extractor fix made this cycle is in effect for every candidate's system, the baselines and h alike when selection is scored (fresh test 1 cards re-extracted only if the extractor changed, the same way for all)

pass.rule: On fresh test 2's eligibility-pass slice the chosen system (PICK+H') beats BOTH rules_full (rules.label on the extracted card) AND base+H' (the untrained Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B, H' on top) on macro-F1: each paired difference (chosen minus baseline, same rows, same draws) has a 95% two-way bootstrap lower bound (2.5th percentile, unrounded) above 0. Both must hold.
pass.accuracy: reported alongside each difference, not used for pass
pass.why: fresh test 1 passed only against skills-free rules, a weak bar: full rules on the card (0.757 / 0.491) and the untrained base + H' (0.720 / 0.463) were the systems the trained model had to beat to show that training added careful reading.

report.slices: all rows and the eligibility-pass slice for every system; every fresh_slices slice for the chosen system, including employer_new_vs_fresh_test1 and employer_shared_with_fresh_test1
report.ceiling: labeler agreement on fresh test 2 (raw agreement and Cohen's kappa of A vs B), on all rows and on the eligibility-pass slice
report.as_is: the result is reported as it comes out, pass or not; no second scoring

rules_and_extractor_fixes.rule: Rules (src/matcher/rules.py, scripts/hybrid_rules.py) or extractor (scripts/extract_postings.py) fixes made this cycle apply to every system and baseline equally: rules_full, rules_skills_free, H' under every model, on fresh test 1 and fresh test 2 alike.
rules_and_extractor_fixes.designed_from: fresh test 1 and training data only; never from fresh test 2 rows, cards, batches or gold
rules_and_extractor_fixes.fresh_test_2_cards: if the extractor changes, fresh test 2's cards are re-extracted with the fixed extractor for every system at once, under a new manifest entry recorded before scoring; the sealed rows, resumes and gold do not change

limitations.employers: fresh test 2 is new at the posting level, not the employer level: 27 of its 32 employers and 82 of its 95 postings (320 of 371 rows) come from employers fresh test 1 also has, and fresh test 1 is open for diagnosis this cycle. The employer_new_vs_fresh_test1 slice is reported; it is too small to carry the bar.
limitations.posting_mix: every remaining test-pool posting was taken, nothing drawn or capped, so short postings weigh more than in fresh test 1: {'teaser 1-699': 23, '1300-3000': 7, '3000+': 55, 'empty': 10}
